itemized.notes: 10-page 2012 filing on the 12_FinancialDisclosureform template. p1 cover, p2 Summary Page (already transcribed upstream), p3 and p6 are the blank Itemized Contributions / Itemized Expenditures grids reading 'Please See Attached', and the money is on three LANDSCAPE computer printouts. ROTATION DIFFERS BETWEEN THE TWO ATTACHMENTS and was checked per file, not assumed: the Income Detail pages 4-5 are rotated 90 deg CW to read (PIL rotate -90) while the Expense Detail page 7 is rotated the OTHER way (PIL rotate +90). Geometry percentages are converted back to the portrait render in each case, so contribution and expenditure rows are narrow bands on opposite axes. PRIVACY / REDACTION: the Income Detail has a 'Full Address' column that is COUNTY-REDACTED - a solid black bar painted over the entire column on both pages - but City, State and ZIP are printed as separate columns and are NOT redacted; city and state are retained per row, ZIP discarded at read time and written nowhere. Several city names are truncated by the column width as printed (Cotton- for Cottonwood Heights, Park C, West S, Bountif-, Hollad-, Chicag, 'South .') and are transcribed truncated, never completed; that truncation is noted per row. One row (Berman, Dan) has EMPTY City/State/ZIP cells, and one row is not a named donor at all - 'Miscellaneous Cash / Pilar Painting Auction', occupation 'n/a' - transcribed verbatim as an aggregate/event line. PAGES 8-10 ARE A DIFFERENT SCHEDULE AND ARE HONESTLY EMPTY: 'Summary Page - Other Campaign Accounts', 'Itemized Contributions from Other Campaign Accounts' and 'Itemized Expenditures from Other Campaign Accounts', each struck through with a diagonal line and hand-marked 'Not Applicable'. They contribute no rows and are not part of the Schedule A/B totals. FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN: the printouts are machine-set with straight columns; date, name and amount counts agree exactly per page (49 / 46 / 14), every date cell is a full m/d/yyyy, and both sides gate exactly on their printed totals. No shift found.
